sources.label: My Morphe patches; mainly focused on financial and productivity/utility apps
sources.author: Aidan
patch_list: Enables Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) push notifications and Live Activities (live game score lockscreen and notification drawer updates) by spoofing the release certificate SHA-1, bypassing Play Services signature checks for MicroG, and…

Removes Google Ad Manager banner and native advertisements, disables Blaze story/moment sponsored placements, blocks Google Interactive Media Ads (IMA) video ad requests, and neutralizes Brightcove IMA mid-roll and pre-roll ad playback.

Removes the OneTrust CMP tracking consent popup, zeros Google Play Advertising ID (AAID), blocks host application analytics, disables Firebase Analytics, AppMeasurement, Firebase Performance Monitoring, Crashlytics, and Sessions telemetry,…
Unlocks the internal Developer Settings menu, Draft Mini Tracker, and NHL GameZone on the Home surface, with independent options for each feature.

Blocks advertisements, sponsored banners, and analytics tracking in NHL article views and embedded web content using bundled NHL rules and optional downloadable filter list subscriptions (EasyList, EasyPrivacy).
